home.title: All your clients in one cozy place
home.lead: A simple, friendly platform for freelancers: keep contacts, take notes and see where every collaboration stands. No clutter, so more time is left for the work that matters.
home.heroAlt: A smiling freelancer working on a laptop by a window with an autumn view
home.eveningAlt: A man working on a laptop in an evening office with a panoramic window
home.aboutText: Freelancing often starts with scattered notes, emails and bookmarks. This platform gathers everything you need to work with clients in one place: who they are, what their company does, what you agreed on and where the collaboration stands. It is a calm workspace with no complicated settings, equally comfortable on a computer and on a phone.

features.title: Clients at hand
features.text: Each client's name, company, email and notes live in a single list, and a client card opens with one click.

features.title: Clear stages
features.text: Every client has a status: lead, active or archived. You can see at a glance who you are working with right now.

features.title: Private access
features.text: The workspace opens once an administrator approves your application, which keeps the platform tidy and secure.

features.title: Your language and theme
features.text: Ukrainian, English, Polish and Czech, a light and a dark theme, and a layout that works well on a phone.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Create an account: all you need is a name, an email and a password.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.text: An administrator reviews your application and opens access to the workspace.

steps.title: Work with clients
steps.text: Once approved, you get the client list and cards with all the details.

home.closingText: Submit your application, it takes a minute. As soon as it is approved, your workspace is ready.
